encode_inputs_batch: encode a batch of Diplomacy game positions into feature tensors for policy and value prediction
encode_orders_strict: encode a single sequence of orders into a feature tensor using strict vocabulary matching
encode_orders_tolerant: encode orders with tolerant parsing that uses the Game object to disambiguate coast-qualified supportees
decode_order_idxs: decode order index tensors back into human-readable order strings from model predictions
get_board_state_size: get the number of feature channels for board state encoding given an input version
